stem.en: Many flowers that bloom at night are white or pale, while many day flowers have strong colours. What is the most likely reason?

text.en: Pale petals show up in dim light for night pollinators

feedback.en: Yes. Pale flowers stand out at night, when bright colours are hard to see.

text.en: Pale petals make the pollen grains heavy, so they stay in place

feedback.en: Colour does not change the weight of pollen.

text.en: Pale petals soak up moonlight, so the flower can make its food

feedback.en: Leaves make a plant's food in sunlight. Petals do not use moonlight for this.

text.en: Pale petals keep the flower warm during the cold hours of night

feedback.en: Pale colours do not warm a flower.

explanation.en: Colours are hard to see in dim light, but white and pale petals still show up. Night-flying pollinators such as moths can find them.

hints.en: Who has to find the flower at night?
What can you see best in dim light?
